channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Speaker begins another round of inquiry into disqualification pleas against four ex-AIADMK MLAs
item.description: Within a few weeks of being elected on AIADMK tickets in the 2026 Assembly elections, Esakki Subaya, S. Jayakumar, P. Sathyabama, and Maragatham Kumaravel resigned their membership of the House and joined the ruling TVK

item.title: J&K court releases two youth after 6 years, says ‘suspicion, however grave, cannot substitute proof’
item.description: The Court directed “immediate release” of the accused, Huzaif Firdous Bhat, a resident of Choora Sopore and Ajaz Ahmad Khan, a resident of Najibhat Kreeri

item.title: Restaurants’ operation suspension was necessary when violations posed extremely serious food safety hazard: Telangana SAFE chief
item.description: Hyderabad’s popular restaurants’ owners request Telangana SAFE Commissioner to issue improvement notices identifying deficiencies and provide establishments with time to rectify them before resorting to suspension, wherever legally permissible

item.title: CRCS raises questions about co-operative society headed by Karnataka MLA Basanagouda Patil Yatnal
item.description: Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies has sought detailed response on investments, audit and liquidity

item.title: Kerala HC allows hotel Radisson Blu in Kochi to operate till 3 a.m.
item.description: Justice Murali Purushothaman sets aside notice by police authorities banning the hotel from operating and conducting DJ parties after 11 p.m.

item.title: Sonia Gandhi trying to justify Emergency, memoir should've been named ‘Whitewashing’: BJP
item.description: The comments from the ruling party came on the day Sonia Gandhi’s memoir was released, in which she weighed in on the Emergency imposed in the country in 1975 and called it a mistake

item.title: Sub-inspector shoots at history-sheeter for attacking him during escape bid in Vellore
item.description: Sub-inspector Raja and suspect Poovarasan were admitted to Government Taluk Hospital in Gudiyatham town

item.title: What is the Gokul Cooperative Milk Federation election issue in Maharashtra? | Explained
item.description: A street fight and a court battle continue, even as voting is to take place today for the election of a chairperson of Gokul Cooperative Milk Federation. What is the issue? What has the Bombay High Court said in its recent verdict?

item.title: Noted cinematographer Shaji Kumar passes away
item.description: Shaji Kumar dies in Kochi at the age of 57 after cardiac failure

item.title: Open letter raises objections to proposed reduction of lake, stormwater drain buffers across Karnataka
item.description: The proposed reductions are driven by real estate interests, disregarding the CPHEEO’s technical guidelines on drainage planning and existing judicial directions on lakes, reads the letter

item.title: Three-year-old girl sexually assaulted in Goa, hospitalised; minister blames outsiders for 90% of such crimes
item.description: The survivor was initially rushed to the Mapusa District Hospital in a critical condition and later shifted to the Goa Medical College and Hospital in Panaji for further treatment, says police spokesperson

item.title: Bihar to host convention in January to draw up roadmap for state's development
item.description: The 'Global Convention on Transforming Bihar 2027' will be held on January 12 and 13 in Patna

item.description: They have challenged seizure of properties worth ₹45.34 crore in India in connection with a company incorporated in Singapore

item.title: CSIR-CCMB team identifies potential new targets to fight Tuberculosis
item.description: Tuberculosis remains a major public health challenge, as treatment requires a combination of antibiotics taken over several months and is becoming increasingly difficult due to the emergence of resistant strains

item.title: Five injured as bus rams into two cars at Wadala traffic signal
item.description: Police moved the damaged vehicles to the roadside to restore normal flow of traffic at the junction

item.title: Tool developed to test teachers’ knowledge of inclusive education
item.description: Nagaland University researchers say the 50-item achievement test is designed to improve teaching practices for children with learning needs

item.title: Social activist Sanjit Bunker Roy dies
item.description: Roy founded the Social Work and Research Centre, popularly known as Barefoot College, in Tilonia in 1972

item.title: Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan to part ways with wife, Anna Lezhneva
item.description: In a joint statement, the couple said that, after sharing a significant part of their lives together, they had decided to separate

item.title: Odisha: 4 held for 'scuffle' with police personnel during Diwali celebrations in Cuttack
item.description: The incident took place when a group of people were bursting firecrackers in Nayasadak area

item.title: PWD entrusted with supervision of Kozhikode-Wayanad tunnel road project in Keralam
item.description: Under new directive, Superintending Engineer of PWD (Roads), Kozhikode North Circle, and Executive Engineers of PWD (Roads) for Kozhikode and Wayanad will directly monitor construction activities. Construction work at all tunnel portals has been temporarily suspended by the government following the debris slip at Kalladi in July

item.title: Major traffic diversions in Kozhikode for Cheruvannur flyover works
item.description: The restrictions came into force from 10 p.m. on November 9 and will remain in effect until 9 p.m. on November 12, during which time all regular traffic through the construction route will be completely barred.

item.title: NCW receives 1.5 lakh complaints annually, domestic violence tops list: Vijaya Rahatkar
item.description: No woman should feel that she could not approach the NCW simply because she did not know how to file a complaint, Vijaya Rahatkar

item.title: Delhi HC directs constitution of committee on demolition of dangerous buildings
item.description: Municipal Corporation of Delhi Commissioner was asked to set up a high-powered committee, in consultation with Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, to devise ways to deal with dangerious and dilapidated buildings

item.title: Newly-inducted J&K Minister Mir Saifullah pledges that NC will ‘restore pre-1953 position, get back J&K flag’
item.description: Mr. Saifullah said Kashmir was reduced to a Union Territory (UT) brazenly on August 5, 2019

item.title: Cyclone Murasu: Heavy rain and power cuts dampen spirit of Deepavali
item.description: Heavy downpour and power cuts have dampened the festival spirit among everyone, right from kids to elderly people and farmers to retail vendors

item.title: Outcry as J&K Bank implements reservation policy pushed by ex-chairman and VHP trustee R.K. Chhibber
item.description: The bank has decided to fill 1,400 vacancies, including 323 probationary officers and 1,033 posts for banking associates, as per the new reservation policy

item.title: What is the bar licence controversy in Keralam | Explained
item.description: Congress-led UDF govt in Keralam has barred the issuance of new liquor licences, including bars and wine and beer parlours, until a formal alcohol policy is unveiled, a move that follows the removal of Excise Commissioner Seeram Sambasiva Rao. Excise Minister M. Liju has signaled a review of licence-granting procedures

item.title: Nine Shigella cases confirmed in Malappuram; Health dept. steps up preventive measures
item.description: Cleaning operations, including super-chlorination of wells and houses in the affected areas, are under way. The family health centre at Elamkulam, near Perinthalmanna, formed a special squad to conduct house-to-house surveillance and create awareness about the infection.

item.title: Keralam cardiologists seek review of order banning re-use of single-use medical devices
item.description: With an increasing proportion of the population requiring advanced cardiac interventions, making complex procedures affordable has become a challenge. Permitting the regulated re-use of select interventional devices, wherever scientifically proven safe, could help reduce costs, say doctors

item.title: NMC cautions students against fake medical colleges, asks them to verify approvals
item.description: The advisory follows the Supreme Court taking cognisance of the issue in an ongoing case in which the court directed regulatory bodies, including the National Medical Commission, to caution students and parents against dealing with unauthorised educational institutions

item.title: Mystery of a missing sewage treatment plant tells the tale of the lake in Krishnakanth Park
item.description: Currently restricted to about three acres and divided into three separate ponds with interconnecting canals, the water body is now set to be increased to 12 acres

item.title: Why has NMC cautioned students against unauthorised medical colleges? | Explained
item.description: The advisory warns that misleading advertisements, websites, social media promotions, unauthorised admission offers and false representations by institutions or agents could leave students and their families vulnerable to fraud

item.title: Why is rural internet connectivity hard to expand? | Explained
item.description: The past few years have seen a major, but not total, reduction in the lack of internet connectivity in rural areas. Why is it hard to make access more universal?

item.title: Building over Srinagar’s future
item.description: Suspend the FAR and land-use exemptions, along with Section 22, until they are brought within the Master Plan framework and subjected to public objections

item.title: Prashant Kishor’s Brahminical criticism of BJP’s Hindutva
item.description: The Jan Suraaj party founder urges Brahmins in Bihar’s Mithila to rethink BJP Hindutva, linking secularism, social justice, and Muslim-OBC political coalitions

item.title: How actor Vijay won a case challenging land allotted to him by Tamil Nadu Housing Board
item.description: Recently, an election petitioner claimed in the Madras High Court that the actor-turned-politician had sold the commercial building with a constructed area of 23,460 sq.ft. for a consideration of ₹35 crore on February 12, 2026

item.title: Return of patriarch: Farooq steps in as NC old guard reasserts influence to check Omar
item.description: In seven decades of the National Conference, the parallel party meeting was seen as a rare implosion and a visible crack that the Opposition parties could exploit to tilt the balance of numbers against the Omar Abdullah government.

item.title: Kochi Corporation plans water security assessment to strengthen city’s resilience
item.description: The project, which will be implemented with technical support from the Kerala Water Authority, is expected to be completed in six months

item.title: Demand grows for alternative greenfield road corridors to Infopark in Kochi
item.description: IT professionals flag safety concerns over narrow, potholed roads and traffic snarls, and call for parallel roads through vacant plots to improve connectivity to Infopark

item.title: Trinamool MLA Paresh Ram Das arrested on charges of rape and extortion
item.description: Several leaders of the Trinamool Congress have been arrested after the BJP came to power in May 2026, which includes five former Ministers

item.title: ED attaches properties in Kashmir in ‘misuse’ of PM Employment Generation Programme scheme case
item.description: An ED spokesman said there was misappropriation of PMEGP Scheme’s loans in criminal conspiracy with the PMEGP borrowers, bank officials of Sumbal Branch and Gamud Gadkhud Branch of J&K Bank and other unknown persons

item.title: Postpone panchayat, municipal elections to April-May next year: Ladakh group
item.description: “We suspect that this government is up to some mischief. We saw ‘vote chori’ in West Bengal, Bihar, Haryana, Maharashtra etc. In entire India 13 crore voters were dropped from the voter list. Ladakh is a small region and fraud is easy,” said Ladakh Buddhist Association (LBA) chairman Tsering Dorjey Lakrook

item.title: Six of family killed in fire at home above grocery store in Maharashtra
item.description: A boy, who was brought downstairs to safety by his parents before they went back in an effort to rescue the others, was the sole survivor

item.title: Rights panel seeks report from LSGD on linking Chilavannur Bund Road with Vyttila-Aroor bypass
item.description: Panel directs the Local Self Government department to convene a meeting of the District Collector, GCDA secretary, and Corporation secretary within a week to decide on funding for the project

item.title: Bengaluru family murders: All seven bodies recovered
item.description: The latest breakthrough came on Monday (November 9, 2026), with the police recovering two more bodies from Shiradi Ghat, in the Western Ghats of Karnataka.

item.title: KSRTC sees sharp rise in ticket bookings during Deepavali, daily reservations cross 62,000
item.description: According to KSRTC officials, the corporation recorded an average of around 62,000 seat reservations over the last three days, compared to its earlier daily average of approximately 37,000.

item.title: Ethanol blend row: Minister stands firm on claim, demands independent fuel testing
item.description: It was the OMC laboratories’ failure to provide the required result that raised suspicion; the samples were then sent to NABL-accredited and ISO-certified laboratories, says Rizwan Arshad

item.title: Policeman beaten to death in Theni over Deepavali celebration dispute
item.description: Special Police Sub-Inspector Senthilkumar was killed while questioning a gang who were filming reels about bursting firecrackers on the road on November 8 night.

item.title: Fisherfolk seek higher compensation for men who died in Murasu cyclone
item.description: Neithal Makkal Katchi’s K. Bharathi said the amount of ₹7 lakh was hardly enough to safeguard the interests of families of those who have lost their sole breadwinners

item.title: Wayanad conservationist N. Badusha wins environmental award
item.description: The award, instituted in memory of Kamarudeen, a noted environmentalist and former Reader in the Department of Botany at the University of Kerala, carries a cash prize of ₹25,000, a citation, and a plaque.

item.title: At peak of air pollution on Deepavali, data goes missing at several government monitoring stations in Delhi
item.description: Missing PM2.5 data for several hours on CPCB website understated city’s pollution levels: experts; 227 PM2.5 observations were missing across 59 stations; govt. will look into it: Mishra

item.title: Ahead of Abu Dhabi peace talks, Modi speaks to Zelenskyy; Jaishankar speaks to Lavrov
item.description: India is ready to mediate to establish grain safety agreement for “food corridors”, says Ukrainian President Zelenskyy

item.title: Five persons, including four girls, drown in irrigation tank in Tiruvannamalai

item.description: Though Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, on his very first day in office, had declared that he had inherited an ‘empty coffer,’ the government has been continuing with all the major welfare measures

item.title: Man kills 4-year-old to sell his organs after watching video on making money quickly
item.description: 27-year-old Basudev Korwa from Chhattisgarh is accused of having murdered his cousin’s son and extracting the boy’s organs, which he allegedly kept in a plastic bag

item.title: Tasmac’s Deepavali sales touch ₹441 crore amid POS machine glitches

item.title: SDPI takes lead in campaign for Tirur district through Malappuram bifurcation
item.description: The party will form a human chain from the Malappuram Collectorate to Tirur on January 26, 2027, Republic Day.

item.title: Raptadu chainsaw attack victim’s condition improving, says A.P. Health Minister
item.description: Dressing has been changed for injuries on her head, neck, face, arms, and back. The wounds are healing well and she is responding positively to the treatment, says Satya Kumar Yadav
